candidate.rollback: Remove the typed identity-ledger projection and restore the rejected v1 checkpoint baseline; no serving pointer is changed.

experiment.uncertainty_rule: Wilson 95% lower bound must exceed the historical baseline rate.

falsifier: Fewer than 20 eligible prospective episodes, success rate below 0.75, Wilson lower bound not above baseline, any critical identity regression, or independent-evaluator rejection.
mechanism: Project immutable entity kinds and permitted relationships into the checkpoint; the model selects a transition but cannot invent cycle hierarchy, language, or pending-decision order.
statement: An engine-supplied typed identity ledger plus explicit response-language and ordering bindings will prevent scope-identity regressions during transitions.
